name: Anisotropine

similar.name: Valproic Acid
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for liver harm and harm to an unborn baby

summary: Anisotropine has estimated low risk scores of 31 for liver problems and 14 for heart problems, but these numbers come from a small computer model rather than tests on people [M]. The drug itself does not have any listed problems in the available data [1][2]. However, a similar drug named Valproic Acid carries a serious warning in the United States for potential liver harm and harm to an unborn baby [3].
